description: Verbatim upstream mechanics. Construction adapters do not replay PHP or establish optimal swaps.

scenarios.excerpt:
gaScenario('automata-genesis-summons-three-titan-mk-ii-tokens-and-the-tonoris-bonus-buffs-each-by-the-token-count')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->champion(cardName: 'Tonoris, Lone Mercenary', lineage: ['Tonoris, Creation\'s Will'])
    ->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Automata Genesis')
    ->play('Automata Genesis')->pay(12)
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 4, 1, 'The champion and three Titan Mk II tokens')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'Counters', '{"buff":3}', 'Three tokens: three buff counters on each')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-3', 'Counters', '{"buff":3}', 'Including the third token')
    ->tested('Automata Genesis')
    ->covers(['summon', 'token', 'tonoris-bonus', 'counter'], '**Summon** three Titan Mk II tokens.', '[Tonoris Bonus] Put **X** **buff** counters on each token ally you control, where **X** is the amount of tokens you control.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('cordelia-aurous-kaiser-enter-summons-two-automaton-drones')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myHand', 'Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser')
    ->play('Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser')->pay(5)
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 4, 1, 'The champion, Cordelia and two Automaton Drone tokens')
    ->tested('Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser')
    ->covers(['on-enter', 'summon', 'token'], '**On Enter:** **Summon** two Automaton Drone tokens.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('cordelia-aurous-kaiser-class-bonus-tokens-are-reservable')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myField', 'Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser')
    ->seed('myField', 'Automaton Drone')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->play('Dungeon Guide')->answer(1, 'myField-2')->answer(1, 'myField-3')->answer(1, 'myField-4')
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 0, 1, 'Nothing was paid from hand: the three tokens were rested instead')
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 7, 1, 'Only the played card left the hand')
    ->tested('Cordelia, Aurous Kaiser')
    ->covers(['class-bonus', 'reservable', 'token'], '[Class Bonus] Token objects you control have **reservable**.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('blade-of-creation-class-bonus-costs-one-less-per-token-and-cleaves')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Blade of Creation', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myField', 'Automaton Drone')->seed('myField', 'Automaton Drone')->seed('myField', 'Automaton Drone')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide', player: 2)->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide', player: 2)
    ->seed('myHand', 'Blade of Creation')
    ->reachTurnThree()
    ->play('Blade of Creation')->pay(4)
    ->expectZoneCount('theirField', 1, 1, 'Cleave: both opposing Dungeon Guides took 4 and died')
    ->expectDamage('p2Field-0', 4, 'And the opposing champion was attacked too')
    ->tested('Blade of Creation')
    ->covers(['class-bonus', 'cost-reduction', 'tokens', 'cleave'], '[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate for each token object you control.', '**Cleave**')
    ->register();

gaScenario('atmos-armor-type-ares-enter-summons-two-atmos-shield-tokens-and-class-bonus-gains-power-per-shield')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Atmos Armor Type-Ares', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myHand', 'Atmos Armor Type-Ares')
    ->play('Atmos Armor Type-Ares')->pay(3)
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 4, 1, 'The ally and two Atmos Shield tokens beside the champion')
    ->expectPower('p1Field-1', 3, '1 power + 1 for each of the two Atmos Shield allies')
    ->tested('Atmos Armor Type-Ares')
    ->covers(['on-enter', 'summon', 'token', 'class-bonus', 'stat-change'], '**On Enter:** **Summon** two Atmos Shield tokens.', '[Class Bonus] CARDNAME gets +1 [POWER] for each ally named Atmos Shield you control.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('production-crawldroid-enter-summons-two-powercell-tokens')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Production Crawldroid')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Production Crawldroid')
    ->play('Production Crawldroid')->pay(3)
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 4, 1, 'The champion, the ally and two Powercell tokens')
    ->tested('Production Crawldroid')
    ->covers(['on-enter', 'summon', 'token'], '**On Enter:** **Summon** two Powercell tokens.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('reactivate-drone-summons-a-rested-automaton-drone-with-a-buff-counter')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Reactivate Drone', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myHand', 'Reactivate Drone')
    ->play('Reactivate Drone')->pay(2)
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'Counters', '{"buff":1}', 'A buff counter')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'Status', '1', 'Rested')
    ->tested('Reactivate Drone')
    ->covers(['summon', 'token', 'counter', 'rested'], '**Summon** an Automaton Drone token rested with a **buff** counter on it.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('tonoris-genesis-aegis-recollection-obelisk')
    ->deckTemplate('lorraine-windslice', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->champion(cardName: 'Tonoris, Genesis Aegis')
    ->endTurn()
    ->endTurn(2)->pass(1)->target('myTempZone-0')
    ->tested('Tonoris, Genesis Aegis')
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 2, 1, 'choosing an Obelisk summons it onto the field')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-1', 'CardID', 'wk0pw0y6is', 'At beginning of recollection phase, choosing Obelisk of Armaments summons it')
    ->register();

gaScenario('archon-broadsword-class-bonus-token-power')
    ->standardDeck('Archon Broadsword')
    ->seed('myField', 'Tonoris, Lone Mercenary', player: 2)
    ->seed('myField', 'Automaton Drone', player: 2)
    ->seed('myField', 'Automaton Drone', player: 2)
    ->seed('myField', 'Archon Broadsword', player: 2, properties: ['Counters' => ['durability' => 1]])
    ->endTurn()
    ->action(2, 10002, 'myField-0!FSM!')->answer(2, 'myField-4')->answer(2, 'theirField-0')->pay(2, 2)->pass(2)
    ->pass(1)
    ->tested('Archon Broadsword')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->expectDamage('p1Field-0', 4, '2 base + 1 [Class Bonus] POWER per token (2 tokens)')
    ->register();

gaScenario('neos-sight-eight-objects-memory-draw')
    ->standardDeck('Neos Sight')
    ->readyFor('Neos Sight')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myField', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Neos Sight')
    ->castSpell('Neos Sight', window: 'me')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 1, 1, 'controlling 8+ objects also draws a card into memory')
    ->register();

gaScenario('dormant-sacrificial-altar-sacrifice-automaton-and-human-mills-two')
    ->deck(<<<'DECK'
# Material
1 Spirit of Fire
# Main
10 Dungeon Guide
10 Fluffy Shopkeep

DECK
    )
    ->seed('myField', 'Dormant Sacrificial Altar')
    ->seed('myField', 'Shieldroid')
    ->seed('myField', 'Coy Bouclier')
    ->deckTop(['Dungeon Guide', 'Fluffy Shopkeep', 'Charge the Soul'])
    ->action(1, 10001, 'myField-1!CustomInput!Activate:0')->target('myField-2')->target('myField-2')
    ->tested('Dormant Sacrificial Altar')
    ->register();

gaScenario('the-eternal-kingdom-class-bonus-domains-you-control-have-reservable')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('The Eternal Kingdom', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myField', 'The Eternal Kingdom')
    ->seed('myField', 'Hub of Innovation')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Cell Production')
    ->play('Cell Production')->pay(2)->answer(1, 'myField-2')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-2', 'Status', '1', 'The domain was rested to pay for 1 of the reserve cost')
    ->tested('The Eternal Kingdom')
    ->covers(['class-bonus', 'reservable', 'static'], '[Class Bonus] Domains you control have **reservable**.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('edge-of-tomorrow-scavenge-eight-for-a-domain-card')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Edge of Tomorrow')
    ->deckTop(['Dungeon Guide', 'Wool Brook'])
    ->seed('myHand', 'Edge of Tomorrow')
    ->castSpell('Edge of Tomorrow', pay: 2, window: '')
    ->expectCardExists('myHand', 'Wool Brook', 'The domain within the top eight was put into the hand')
    ->tested('Edge of Tomorrow')
    ->covers(['scavenge'], '**Scavenge 8** for a domain card.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('lost-wisdom-class-bonus-with-a-unique-ally-costs-two-less-and-returns-a-spell-to-memory')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Dungeon Guide')
    ->readyFor('Lost Wisdom', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myField', 'Camil, Basked Abundance')
    ->seed('myGraveyard', 'Purification')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Lost Wisdom')
    ->castSpell('Lost Wisdom', pay: 2, window: '')->answer(1, 'myGraveyard-0')
    ->expectCardExists('myMemory', 'Purification', 'The Spell card returned from the graveyard to memory')
    ->tested('Lost Wisdom')
    ->covers(['class-bonus', 'cost-reduction', 'zone-movement'], '[Class Bonus] This card costs 2 less to activate if you control one or more unique allies.', 'Return a Spell card from your graveyard to your memory.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('imperial-apprentice-spell-activation-banishes-a-floating-memory-card-to-draw')
    ->standardDeck('Imperial Apprentice')
    ->readyFor('Imperial Apprentice')
    ->seed('myField', 'Imperial Apprentice')
    ->seed('myGraveyard', 'Croaking Webfoot')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Bolt of Diamonds')
    ->castSpell('Bolt of Diamonds', pay: 2, target: 'theirField-0')->answer(1, 'myGraveyard-0')->pass(1)->pass(2)
    ->expectZoneCount('myBanish', 1, 1, 'The floating memory card was banished')
    ->expectDamage('p2Field-0', 1, 'The Bolt of Diamonds resolved')
    ->tested('Imperial Apprentice')
    ->covers(['triggered-ability', 'spell-activation', 'floating-memory', 'banish', 'draw'], 'Whenever you activate a Spell card, you may banish a card with **floating memory** from your graveyard. If you do, draw a card.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('winbless-forecaster-adds-one-to-enlighten-counters-put-on-your-champion')
    ->deckTemplate('quiet', 'Winbless Forecaster')
    ->readyFor('Winbless Forecaster', classBonus: true)
    ->seed('myField', 'Winbless Forecaster')
    ->seed('myField', 'Windrider Mage')
    ->reachTurnThree()
    ->answer(1, 'YES')
    ->expectProperty('p1Field-0', 'Counters', '{"_overrides":{"classes":"MAGE"},"enlighten":2}', 'Windrider Mage puts one enlighten counter on the champion; the Forecaster makes it two')
    ->tested('Winbless Forecaster')
    ->covers(['replacement-effect', 'counter'], 'If one or more **enlighten** counters would be put on your champion, that many plus one **enlighten** counters are put on your champion instead.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('primeval-ritual-sacrifices-an-ally-and-returns-a-wind-card-to-memory')
    ->standardDeck('Primeval Ritual')
    ->readyFor('Primeval Ritual')
    ->seed('myField', 'Giant Tortoise')
    ->seed('myGraveyard', 'Aenean Reclaim')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Primeval Ritual')
    ->play('Primeval Ritual')->answer(1, 'myField-1')->pay(3)->pass(1)->answer(1, 'myGraveyard-0')
    ->expectCardExists('myGraveyard', 'Giant Tortoise', 'The sacrificed ally is in the graveyard')
    ->expectCardExists('myMemory', 'Aenean Reclaim', 'The wind card returned from the graveyard to memory')
    ->expectZoneCount('myField', 1, 1, 'The ally was sacrificed: only the champion remains')
    ->expectZoneCount('myMemory', 4, 1, 'Three paid cards plus the returned card')
    ->tested('Primeval Ritual')
    ->covers(['additional-cost', 'sacrifice', 'zone-movement'], 'As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice an ally.', 'Return target wind element card from your graveyard to your memory.')
    ->register();

gaScenario('primeval-ritual-cannot-be-activated-without-an-ally-to-sacrifice')
    ->standardDeck('Primeval Ritual')
    ->readyFor('Primeval Ritual')
    ->seed('myGraveyard', 'Aenean Reclaim')
    ->seed('myHand', 'Primeval Ritual')
    ->action(1, 10002, 'myHand-7!FSM!')
    ->expectDqEmpty()
    ->expectZoneCount('myHand', 8, 1, 'Nothing happened: the additional cost cannot be paid')
    ->expectZoneCount('myGraveyard', 1, 1, 'The graveyard card stayed put')
    ->tested('Primeval Ritual')
    ->covers(['additional-cost', 'restriction'], 'As an additional cost to activate this card, sacrifice an ally.')
    ->register();
